cli_commands.description: Place entities using the top-left occupied tile as the anchor.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-build --entity name,anchor-x,anchor-y,dir [--entity ...] [--no-clear]    or: factorio.py act-build --entities-json <json> [--no-clear] Direction: 0=north (up), 4=east (right), 8=south (down), 12=west (left). Note: The character walks into reach using native pathfinding. Trees and rocks in the footprint are mined before placement unless --no-clear is given.

cli_commands.description: Expand a Factorio blueprint string and build it in batches of at most 50 entities.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-build-blueprint --blueprint-file <path> [--anchor x,y] [--dry-run] [--no-clear]    or: factorio.py act-build-blueprint --blueprint <string> [--anchor x,y] [--dry-run] [--no-clear] Position: blueprint positions are map coordinates; --anchor moves the whole plan so its top-left tile lands there. Directions: 0=north (up), 4=east (right), 8=south (down), 12=west (left). Underground: underground-belt/pipe-to-ground input/output subtypes are preserved as underground_type. Dry run: prints the expanded entities, placement analysis, and missing items without building. Note: Recip

cli_commands.description: Copy settings from source to target entities (synchronous, reach-checked).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-copy-settings --target source-x,source-y,target-x,target-y [--target ...] [--dry-run]    or: factorio.py act-copy-settings --targets-json <json> [--dry-run] Note: Not a walking job; move the character into reach of every source and target first. Unreachable or incompatible pairs are reported and never mutated.

cli_commands.description: Queue a handcraft and verify its products appear (or use --no-wait).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-craft --item <name> --count <n> [--no-wait]

cli_commands.description: Remove items from an entity at x,y into player inventory.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-extract --entity x,y --item <name> --count <n|all> Note: The character walks into reach using native pathfinding.

cli_commands.description: Move items from player inventory into an entity at x,y.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-insert --entity x,y --item <name> --count <n> Note: The character walks into reach using native pathfinding.

cli_commands.description: Launch a ready rocket silo at target tile coordinates.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-launch-rocket --target x,y [--target ...]    or: factorio.py act-launch-rocket --targets-json <json> Note: Walks into reach. Success means launch initiated; the benchmark waits for an actual launch.

cli_commands.description: Mine a resource or entity at target tile coordinates.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-mine --target x,y [--target ...] [--resource [name]]    or: factorio.py act-mine --targets-json <json> Resource mode excludes the character and prioritizes the requested resource deterministically. Note: The character walks into reach and performs one native mining cycle per target (one extraction for a resource vein).

cli_commands.description: Move the player through paced, collision-checked steps to target tile coordinates.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-move --target x,y [--target ...]    or: factorio.py act-move --targets-json <json> Note: Stops and returns partial progress if an intermediate step is blocked.

cli_commands.description: Start researching a technology.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-research --technology <name>

cli_commands.description: Rotate entities at target tile coordinates (first entity at each point).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-rotate --target x,y [--target ...] [--direction 0|4|8|12]    or: factorio.py act-rotate --targets-json <json> Direction: 0=north (up), 4=east (right), 8=south (down), 12=west (left). With --direction the entity is rotated until it faces that direction (max 4 steps), so one call sets the final orientation. Note: The character walks into reach using native pathfinding.

cli_commands.description: Set the recipe on assemblers at target tile coordinates.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py act-set-recipe --target x,y,recipe [--target ...]    or: factorio.py act-set-recipe --targets-json <json> Note: The character walks into reach using native pathfinding.

cli_commands.description: List blueprints recorded for a run (active run by default).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py blueprint-list [--run-id <id>]

cli_commands.description: Persist a designed blueprint string for the active run without building it.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py blueprint-save --blueprint-file <path> [--label <text>] [--description <text>] [--source saved|built] [--run-id <id>]    or: factorio.py blueprint-save --blueprint <string> [--label <text>]

cli_commands.description: Place 2x2 turrets spaced along a line with a single wall row in front.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py build-defense-line --from x,y --to x,y [--turret name] [--wall name|--no-wall] [--spacing n] [--ammo-chest name] [--no-clear] Front side is +y for horizontal lines and +x for vertical lines; single wall layer, no gates/power.
cli_commands.usage: Usage: factorio.py build-defense-line --from x,y --to x,y [--turret name] [--wall name|--no-wall] [--spacing n] [--ammo-chest name] [--no-clear]

cli_commands.description: Place input+output inserters around rows of machines.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py build-inserter-pairs --entity x,y[,w,h] [--entity ...] [--direction east|west|north|south] [--name inserter] [--no-clear]    or: factorio.py build-inserter-pairs --entities-json <json> [--direction ...] [--no-clear] Footprints default to 3x3; pass w,h for other machine sizes. Shared machine-to-machine inserters are deduped.
cli_commands.usage: Usage: factorio.py build-inserter-pairs --entity x,y[,w,h] [--entity ...] [--direction east|west|north|south] [--name inserter] [--no-clear]

cli_commands.description: Place mining drills on a grid over ore tiles with belt rows and an output chest.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py build-mining-outpost --ore x,y [--ore ...] [--drill name] [--drill-size w,h] [--output name] [--no-clear]    or: factorio.py build-mining-outpost --area x,y,radius [--drill name] [--drill-size w,h] [--output name] Warning: one output-belt row between drill rows is not mined; electric drills need a power network.
cli_commands.usage: Usage: factorio.py build-mining-outpost --ore x,y [--ore ...] [--drill name] [--drill-size w,h] [--output name] [--no-clear]

cli_commands.description: Lay an L-shaped surface pipe line (x first, then y).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py build-pipe-line --from x,y --to x,y [--name pipe] [--no-clear] Note: surface pipes only; for straight runs under obstacles use build-underground-pipe.
cli_commands.usage: Usage: factorio.py build-pipe-line --from x,y --to x,y [--name pipe] [--no-clear]

cli_commands.description: Place a pole grid covering entity targets or a scan area.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py build-power-network --target x,y[,w,h] [--target ...] [--pole name] [--big-pole-every n] [--no-clear]    or: factorio.py build-power-network --area x,y,radius [--pole name] [--big-pole-every n] [--no-clear] Coverage: small pole supply area 5x5, 5-tile grid so adjacent poles are within wire reach.
cli_commands.usage: Usage: factorio.py build-power-network --target x,y[,w,h] [--target ...] [--pole name] [--big-pole-every n] [--no-clear]

cli_commands.description: Lay a straight underground-belt line (input/output pairs + surface belt connectors).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py build-underground-belt --from x,y --to x,y [--name transport-belt] [--max-distance n] [--no-clear] Name: transport-belt/fast-transport-belt/express-transport-belt (default distance 4/6/8); pass --max-distance to override. Pair layout: input at the segment start, output at start+distance facing the same flow direction, one surface belt connector after each pair, surface belts for tails shorter than a pair. Straight horizontal/vertical only.
cli_commands.usage: Usage: factorio.py build-underground-belt --from x,y --to x,y [--name transport-belt] [--max-distance n] [--no-clear]

cli_commands.description: Lay a straight pipe-to-ground line (input/output pairs + surface pipe connectors).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py build-underground-pipe --from x,y --to x,y [--max-distance n] [--no-clear] Pair layout: input at the segment start, output at start+distance facing the same flow direction, one surface pipe connector after each pair, surface pipes for tails shorter than a pair (default distance 10). Straight only.
cli_commands.usage: Usage: factorio.py build-underground-pipe --from x,y --to x,y [--max-distance n] [--no-clear]

cli_commands.description: Observe an area and remove the entities with native mining (chunked).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py deconstruct-area --center-x <n> --center-y <n> --radius <n> [--limit <n>] [--types a,b] [--filters a,b] [--include-all] [--max-per-job <n>] [--dry-run] Defaults: radius 64, limit server default (300), player_only=true (last_user heuristic). --include-all sets player_only=false; add --types tree,simple-entity for passability or --types resource for ore. Removal is the normal native miner: the character walks, mining takes real time, and unreachable targets fail per entity. Jobs are split into batches of at most 50 targets (--max-per-job smaller). --dry-run plans only.

cli_commands.description: Request cancellation after the current atomic action.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py job-cancel --job-id <id>

cli_commands.description: Read action job progress.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py job-status --job-id <id>

cli_commands.description: List entities for deconstruction planning in an area (name/type/position/status).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-area --center-x <n> --center-y <n> --radius <n> [--limit <n>] [--types a,b] [--filters a,b] [--player-only]

cli_commands.description: Read enemy nests/units, own turrets (ammo/health) and player health.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-combat --center-x <n> --center-y <n> --radius <n> Defaults: player position, radius 64. Recent damage is not derivable; compare player.health across calls.

cli_commands.description: Audit inserter/belt/machine links and report dead ends or reversed links.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-connections --center-x <n> --center-y <n> --radius <n>

cli_commands.description: Dry-run source/target compatibility and reach report for settings copy.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-copy-settings --target source-x,source-y,target-x,target-y [--target ...]    or: factorio.py observe-copy-settings --targets-json <json> Note: The character must be in reach of both entities; move first.

cli_commands.description: Inspect entity status, fuel, fluids, recipe, inventory.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-entity --target x,y [--target ...]    or: factorio.py observe-entity --targets-json <json>

cli_commands.description: Look up entity dimensions, fluid connections, energy info.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-entity-prototype --name <entity-name>

cli_commands.description: Summarize power, fuel, and entity status counts in a window.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-factory --center-x <n> --center-y <n> --radius <n>

cli_commands.description: List fluid networks, levels and capacities around a window.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-fluids --center-x <n> --center-y <n> --radius <n> Defaults: player position, radius 32.

cli_commands.description: Render a region as an ASCII map (belts, inserters, machines, terrain).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-layout --center-x <n> --center-y <n> --radius <n> --step <n>

cli_commands.description: Read a player-charted map window; uncharted chunks are masked.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-map --center-x <n> --center-y <n> --radius <n>

cli_commands.description: Compact downsampled charted map thumbnail with uncharted/water/land/entity/resource/player glyphs.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-map-overview --center-x <n> --center-y <n> --radius <n> --size <n> [--format svg] Radius is clamped to 1024 tiles and size to 160 cells; only charted chunks are revealed.

cli_commands.description: Analyze buildability without consuming an item.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-placement --entity name,anchor-x,anchor-y,dir [--entity ...]

cli_commands.description: Inspect player position, health, inventories, and equipment.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-player --limit-inventory <n> --limit-equipment <n>

cli_commands.description: Read per-minute production/consumption rates from the manager's telemetry sampler.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-production

cli_commands.description: List available recipes and their ingredients/products.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-recipes --limit-recipes <n> [--unlocked-only]

cli_commands.description: Get current, queued, available, locked, and completed technologies with costs.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-research --limit-available <n> --limit-locked <n> --limit-completed <n>

cli_commands.description: Scan for resource patches in a radius.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-resources --window-x <n> --window-y <n> --radius <n>

cli_commands.description: One call returning player, factory, research and production observations.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-snapshot --center-x <n> --center-y <n> --radius <n> Note: sequential requests; saves round trips and prompt tokens versus four separate calls.

cli_commands.description: Fetch compact RLE terrain and entities in a charted window.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py observe-world --window-x <n> --window-y <n> --radius <n> --include terrain,entities

cli_commands.description: Ask the native pathfinder for a route without walking it.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py path-preview --target x,y Returns ok=true with path waypoints when reachable; ok=false error=no_path when blocked (water/cliff/buildings). Use this before long or unseen-terrain moves; route around water/cliff instead of retrying the same no_path target.

cli_commands.description: List available save files on the server.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py server-saves

cli_commands.description: Launch the graphical local host with the given save.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py server-start --save <name>.zip

cli_commands.description: Show whether the server is running and RCON is connected.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py server-status

cli_commands.description: Stop the running server (saves and exits).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py server-stop

cli_commands.description: Read the active run's STATE.md freshness/status.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py state-show

cli_commands.description: Write/refresh STATE.md (resets the update deadline gate).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py state-write --current <text> [--done-when <text>] [--next <text>] [--scores production=50,logistics=40,...] [--objective <text>] [--timebox <text>] [--progress <text>] [--notes <text>] [--markdown <text>] Mutating actions are refused with STATE_UPDATE_REQUIRED once STATE.md is too old; call this to continue.

cli_commands.description: Fetch the generated tool manifest (client methods, parameters, CLI usage, manager endpoints).
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py tools [--json] [--local] [--query <text>] --json prints the manifest as JSON; --local introspects factorio.py without the manager; --query filters matching commands/methods/endpoints. (The manager also serves GET /api/agent/tools?q=...)

cli_commands.description: Sleep locally for N milliseconds between actions.
cli_commands.help: Usage: factorio.py wait --ms <n>
